scenes.title: GROUND PASS
scenes.note: Resolved 13.2 m/s pass, rolling-consistent spin. No foot force needed.

scenes.title: DRIVEN PASS
scenes.note: Slight lift, then real bounce and slip into rolling.

scenes.title: LOFTED PASS
scenes.note: Backspin and gravity carry the ball; contact determines the landing.

scenes.title: POWER SHOT
scenes.note: Existing power family ratio 0.271 at 29 m/s. Physical goal frame.

scenes.title: CURVED SHOT
scenes.note: 45 rad/s actual sidespin. Magnus bends free flight; no target tracking.

scenes.title: CHIP
scenes.note: Charge 0.6 legacy chip velocity; explicit backspin added for V1.

scenes.title: SLIDE → ROLL
scenes.note: Zero initial spin. Contact friction exchanges translation and rotation.

scenes.title: POST REBOUND
scenes.note: Off-centre 31 m/s post contact; spin, normal and friction determine rebound.

scenes.title: CROSSBAR REBOUND
scenes.note: Crossbar collision uses the same swept sphere response as the posts.

scenes.title: SHIN DEFLECTION
scenes.note: Actual V2 tapered shin collider. No scripted outgoing direction.
